answer: An equivocation-proof bond stops fake identities. Each newcomer locks 60 credits and posts one signed claim in a horizon ledger, one key, one claim. Auditors pair claims; a delta between two claims from one key proves double-signing and burns the bond. An echo check replays each claim. First 40, k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, 60,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented keys cannot sign twice. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep the bond.
